rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the grapefruit fruit.

example.english: I ate half a grapefruit this morning.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 sik6 zo2 bun3 go3 sai1 jau2

rows.note: Use this specifically when referring to the grapefruit tree rather than its fruit.

example.english: That grapefruit tree bears lots of fruit every year.
example.traditional: 嗰邊棵西柚樹年年都結好多果。
example.jyutping: go2 bin1 fo2 sai1 jau2 syu6 nin4 nin4 dou1 git3 hou2 do1 gwo2
